data.description: A skilled warrior of the dwarven nations.
data.name: Dwarven Warrior

data.description: A blaze of claw and fang.  The speed of these netherworld creatures is without compare.
data.name: Cacodaemon Warrior

data.description: Normally, they feed on only the dead.  In times of hunger, they will often hunt their prey.
data.name: Carrion Worm

data.description: Beaten when young, these evil people make a poor choice of company.
data.name: Master Assassin

data.description: They travel in large packs to avoid falling prey to more powerful demons.
data.name: Vrack

data.description: Often found in large packs, these small but powerful demons should be avoided.
data.name: Small Demon

data.description: A small, but deadly variety of your every day troll.
data.name: Necrite Troll

spells: Classic Major Spell Deflector Priest Enchanter

data.description: Created from nonliving parts and given life through arcane magic.  They will serve their creator until destroyed.
data.name: Golem

data.description: Ratius Giantous
data.name: Cave Rat

data.description: Over two feet of mindless insect. Capable of overwhelming foes by their sheer numbers.
data.name: Giant Ant

data.description: A worm the size of which even the gods have never seen.  A true freak of nauture.
data.name: Giant Carnivorous Worm

data.description: They stand 16 feet at the shoulder. These gargantuan humanoids have grown civil enough to live in harmony with humans, elves, and other more civilized races.
data.name: Rock Giant

data.description: An underground dweller that is more reptile than man.  They hate all surface dwellers.
data.name: Troglodyte

data.description: A larger version of the worker ant. Bred to do battle and defend the nest.
data.name: Warrior Ant

data.description: The central brains behind an ant colony.  Her death is the death of the colony.
data.name: Queen Ant

data.description: Resembling ghouls, these vile creatures often live among their lesser cousins.
data.name: Ghast

data.description: Minotaurs have a stout body that would make even an ogre quake with fright.   These powerful creatures love to engage in combat.
data.name: Minotaur Champion

data.description: Skilled in the ways of thievery as well as war.  These vile thugs would just as soon slit your throat as look at you.
data.name: Warrior Thief

data.description: With a shell as dark as soot, this crab is a mindless eating machine with powerful pincers.
data.name: Coal Crab

data.description: With a hard carapace as tough as steel plating, this crab is like a knight in armor.
data.name: Bone Crab

data.description: Large glands in the pincers inject victims with a powerful chemical that bursts into flame when it comes in contact with air.
data.name: Fire Crab

data.description: Thousands of tiny spots give this crab its name.  Though nowhere near as fast as a leopard, it is just as deadly.
data.name: Leopard Crab

data.description: A powerful warrior who has been polymorphed into a goblin.
data.name: Shalutie

data.description: Pawns of the frost giants.  These weak-minded fools often do the bidding of the giants and fight by their side.
data.name: Snow Yeti

data.description: A hideous being which feeds on the mental energy of its victims.  Once the mental energy is drained, it feeds on the actual physical brain.
data.name: Anti'id

spells: Classic Minor Spell Deflector Priest Enchanter
Classic Minor Spell Deflector Priest Enchanter

data.description: A race of giants that was trapped in the Abyss during the great upheaval.  They are one of the few good races that calls the Abyss home.
data.name: Rothian Giant

spells: Classic Major Spell Deflector Priest Enchanter
Classic Minor Spell Deflector Priest Enchanter

data.description: A rothian giant guide.  He smells of strong wine and moldy leather.  He is well-known for his cowardly ways.
data.name: Tivrish

spells: Classic Minor Spell Deflector Priest Enchanter

data.description: Often used to guard magical treasure or some important location.
data.name: Calthop

data.description: Loners in the world of the Abyss.  They are among the rarest of demons.  It is rumored that only a few clans of these demons still survive.
data.name: Pitted Demon

data.description: Earl of the Undead, Huntoo is a powerful ruler in the Abyss and arch rival of Lord Pusswart.
data.name: Huntoo

data.description: The name is only part of the story.  These foul-tempered creatures stink to high heaven and have a face no mother could love.
data.name: Stench Demon

data.description: Souls that have been damned to roam the astral plane.  If provoked, they can exist on the material plane for short periods.
data.name: Wraith

data.description: Often found in the company of ghouls, ghasts and other ilk of that manner.  These fiends have an endless appetite for flesh, either alive or dead.
data.name: Flesh Fiend

data.description: They are extremely rare even on their own plane of existence.  The shadow mite is immune to projectile weapons.
data.name: Shadow Mite

data.description: The black sheep of the Abyss.  Half demon, half devil.  They are often shunned by full-blooded demons and devils.
data.name: Hellion

data.description: A mutated mushman, fungoids are extremely rare... and deadly.
data.name: Fungoid

data.description: These malevelent creatures are immune to cold based spells.  They also have a nasty bite.
data.name: Frost Drake

data.description: These beasts are no more than slaves to the evil eys.  They serve as hands for those that have none.  They are imensly strong.
data.name: Ice Ogre

data.description: Weak in mind and body, these demons are lightning quick.  They are cowards in battle and will surrender or run easily.
data.name: Demon

data.description: Incredibly strong, these demons rule over whole races of lesser ilk.  They prefer to pummle their enemies with bare hands and magic.
data.name: Demon Lord

data.description: Existing on both the material plane and the astral plane simultaneously.  They can inflict massive chemical damage.
data.name: Astral Ooze

data.description: Nomally happy to stand around and chew cud.  These creatures can be dangerous if they stampede.
data.name: Herd Animal

data.description: These vermin carry a deadly disease.  They breed so rapidly there are always plenty to take the place of those that perish.
data.name: Diseased Rat

data.description: Arch rival of the Black Knight, he is in eternal search for his nemesis.  Each has sworn to slay the other in a blood oath that has lasted for years.
data.name: Green Knight

data.description: Little can stand in the way of a rampaging titan.  These huge folk have little trouble with the evil vulk of the Abyss.
data.name: Titan Warrior

data.description: Common in some areas of the Abyss that have a cold climate.  No dragon in the Realmz can match this breed when it comes to having a heart of pure evil.
data.name: Ice Dragon

data.description: Formed from a colony of semi-intelligent mosses.
data.name: Mushoid

data.description: A real monster.  Fortunately, this eight-legged monstrosity has NO venom.
data.name: Giant Widow

data.description: A huge animal with tusks as long as most men are tall.  Stand aside!   Do not block the path of a rampaging behemoth.
data.name: Behemoth

data.description: Be careful not to fall victim to a bite from one of these.  Their bite has been known to cause paralysis.
data.name: Trench Spider

data.description: Little is known about the greckle for they are solitary creatures that dabble in the black arts.
data.name: Greckle

data.description: Long ago, a tribe of trolls developed the ability to think.  Since then, they have developed a strong tribal society that rivals orcs and goblins.
data.name: Stygian Troll

data.description: A powerful leader in the Abyss.  Arch rival of Huntoo (Earl of the Undead).
data.name: Lord Pusswart

data.description: Half tiger, half humanoid.  This delightful race relishes all that is good in life.  How ironic that they are only found in the Abyss.
data.name: Tigtaur

data.description: Old crypts are the favorite haunt of these foul vermin.  Though named as a troll, these creatures are no relation to true trolls.
data.name: Barrow Troll

data.description: A magical being summoned by the hand of a mighty wizard.  Once summoned, they will carry out their master's will until destroyed.
data.name: Earth Animation

data.description: Created eons ago as punishment by the gods, this foul race is feared by even the most evil and powerful wizards that walk the Realmz.
data.name: Gorgon

data.description: An evil experiment of some mad devil gone awry.  Part green dragon, part gargoyle, all bad temper.
data.name: Viperion

data.description: A snake of unbelievable size.  Easily  60 feet in length and as large around as a full-grown bull vusk.
data.name: Mammoth Snake

data.description: In life, a formerly valiant warrior. In death, he is now a cursed pawn of evil.
data.name: Skeletal Knight

data.description: Capable of traveling through earth as you or I through air.  You may never be prepared for these creatures, since they attack from below.
data.name: Earth Wyrmm

data.description: Hailing from some unknown plane, these beasts are often summoned by powerful enchanters to perform their bidding.
data.name: Cacodaemon Warlord

data.description: This most beguiling of devils preys on the sexual impulses of mortals.  Taking the shape of a beautiful man or woman, they lure unsuspecting souls to their doom.
data.name: Succubus

data.description: These minor demons live their lives as servants to those more powerful than themselves.
data.name: Winged Demon

data.description: Born of pure evil.  These beautiful, deadly creatures love to inhabit murky forests.
data.name: Emerald Dragon

data.description: Large and fierce, this race of beings is known to only exist on the planes of the Abyss.
data.name: Xyfin

data.description: A close cousin to the red dragon.  These creatures are more common in the Abyss than on the material plane.
data.name: Fire Drake

data.description: A member of a cult of dwarves. They wish to bring about the union of the Realmz and the Abyss.
data.name: Doomsayer Warrior

data.description: A small reptilian creature that is extremely ferocious.  They are often used as fodder in wars between demon lords.  They are not of demonic descent.
data.name: Ezak

data.description: One of the Hemerood.  God-like in power.  This evil race is making its way back to the known Realmz for the first time in 50 millenia.
data.name: Hemerood

spells: Classic Minor Spell Deflector Priest Enchanter
Classic Minor Spell Deflector Priest Enchanter

data.description: Slightly larger and more powerful than goblins, these close cousins to true goblins band together in large tribes.
data.name: Hob Goblin

data.description: Living on the frigid planes of the Abyss, this vile race will attack any goodly race on sight.
data.name: Frigid Giant

data.description: A minotaur adventurer who is willing to put up with your company.  He knows that danger follows you and wishes to get in on the action.
data.name: Minotaur Adventurer

data.description: A brave but somewhat unskilled troop.
data.name: Warrior

data.description: A conscript with little to look forward to in the civilian world.  For this reason they often reenlist to become corporals.
data.name: Warrior Corporal

data.description: Charged to keep the troops in line.
data.name: Warrior Sergeant

data.description: A true leader of men.
data.name: Warrior Lieutenant

data.description: Skilled in the ways of combat and leadership.  An up and coming officer.
data.name: Warrior Captain
